calls.summary:
# Berlin Exp Meetup - Post Event Debrief
Date: 2026-10-19 | Duration: 29m

## Summary
The event strengthened Growth Book’s visibility through Hampus Poppius’ talk, Graham’s panel participation, and prominent branding, reaching approximately 100 identified users or buyers. T-shirts, socks, and water bottles attracted attendees, although only five water bottles were available. The team concluded that specialized experimentation meetups provide better access to relevant practitioners and more effective mingling than large conferences, but are better suited to awareness and relationship-building than immediate sales pipeline creation. They also identified the need to clarify sponsor boundaries when events are hosted at Zalando venues, particularly because Zalando uses Epo. Follow-up actions include reviewing unassigned accounts, adding relationship context, resolving HelloFresh parent-child records, routing assigned contacts through HubSpot, and placing others into marketing nurture. The team will pursue London sponsorship, consolidate event materials, and complete expense reporting.

## Keywords
Experimentation meetups, Event sponsorship, Growth Book visibility, Lead follow-up, HubSpot account assignment, Marketing nurture
